svg.title: Sum all nine products to get one output number
svg.desc: Select the top-left 3×3 patch of a 7×7 input containing 1 through 49. Elementwise multiplication by weights [[1,2,-1],[-2,1,3],[2,-1,1]] gives [[1,4,-3],[-16,9,30],[30,-16,17]]. Summing gives 56, and adding bias 2 gives the first output value 58. products remains a 3×3 array until its elements are summed.
svg.text: Sum all nine products to get one output number
1 image · 1 input channel · first filter, first position
This result is still a (3, 3) array.
Add the bias once, after summing the nine products.
At the next position, move the input patch and reuse the same weights.
